title: Interfaces PPPoE parity depth pass (IF-15 subset)
acceptance_criteria: PPPoE GUI supports DHCPv6 Prefix Delegation row CRUD (pd id/length/interface/address/sla-id).
PPPoE parser/model round-trips DHCPv6-PD rows from config-tree payloads.
PPPoE save flow validates malformed PD rows and returns deterministic UI errors.
PPPoE operation generation emits deterministic set/delete commands for DHCPv6-PD changes.
Frontend gates pass (typecheck, targeted eslint, build, runtime smoke, UI smoke).
assumptions: IF-15 remains partial after this slice because ethernet/loopback/wireguard advanced leaves are still pending.
PPPoE operation-mode connect/disconnect controls are deferred; this slice targets configuration-tree parity depth.

Proceed with next IF-15 parity slices for ethernet/loopback/wireguard option depth.
